note: The RAR5 owner extra field supplies the user-name length varint; the candidate encodes value_len as 256.
The input-controlled length is compared to OWNER_MAXNAMELEN; equality is not treated as too long.
When value_len equals OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, name_len becomes 256 even though namebuf has only indices 0 through 255 before the terminator write.
Exactly 256 input bytes are copied into the 256-byte stack buffer, filling it with no space left for a trailing NUL.
The terminator is written at index 256, one byte past char namebuf[OWNER_MAXNAMELEN], causing the stack-buffer-overflow.
